footer.tagline: Drag, drop, and complete fun cartoon puzzles!

hero.title: Pick a scene and snap every piece into place
hero.subtitle: Choose from colorful cartoon puzzles, drag each piece onto the full picture, and complete the scene one connection at a time.

levels.title: Choose your puzzle
levels.subtitle: Every scene is a full cartoon image broken into pieces, ready to be rebuilt.

steps.title: How the puzzle works
steps.subtitle: Four simple steps to turn scattered pieces into a finished cartoon scene.

items.title: Pick a scene
items.description: Select a cartoon puzzle from the level list based on its difficulty and piece count.

items.title: Pieces shuffle in
items.description: Every piece of the full image scatters around the board, ready to be sorted.

items.title: Drag and connect
items.description: Drop each piece onto its matching spot and watch it snap into the correct position.

items.title: Complete the picture
items.description: Keep connecting pieces until the full cartoon image is rebuilt and the level is cleared.

cta.title: Ready to rebuild your first scene?
cta.subtitle: Jump into the easiest unlocked puzzle and start connecting pieces right away.

results.subtitle: All {pieces} pieces found their place. Here's how your run stacked up.
results.nextSubtitle: Keep the streak going or compare notes with other puzzlers.

hero.eyebrow: A cartoon puzzle game for curious minds
hero.subtitle: Pick a colorful cartoon scene, pull its scattered pieces into place one by one, and watch the full picture snap together. Simple to play, satisfying to finish.
hero.imageAlt: A colorful cartoon jungle scene being assembled from puzzle pieces

howItWorks.title: Four easy steps to a finished picture
howItWorks.subtitle: No timers, no penalties, just a calm drag-and-drop flow built for focus and fun.

steps.title: Pick a scene
steps.description: Choose a cartoon picture from jungle, ocean, space, and more themed packs.

steps.title: Grab a piece
steps.description: Drag any scattered piece from the tray with your mouse or finger.

steps.title: Drop it in place
steps.description: Pieces snap into their correct spot the moment you drop them close enough.

steps.title: Reveal the picture
steps.description: Place the final piece and watch the whole cartoon come together with a celebration.

packs.title: Six cartoon worlds to piece together
packs.subtitle: Every pack is hand-illustrated and split into bite-sized puzzles for different skill levels.

items.name: Jungle Safari
items.description: Lions, parrots, and elephants hiding among the vines.

items.name: Under the Sea
items.description: A coral reef bursting with fish, bubbles, and a friendly octopus.

items.name: Space Explorers
items.description: Rockets, planets, and a wandering comet across the stars.

items.name: Enchanted Forest
items.description: A glowing treehouse surrounded by fireflies and toadstools.

items.name: Dino World
items.description: Friendly dinosaurs roam a prehistoric valley at sunset.

items.name: Farmyard Friends
items.description: A busy barnyard full of cows, chickens, and a sleepy pig.

features.title: Made for short sessions and big smiles
features.subtitle: Every detail is tuned for little hands and short attention spans without feeling babyish.

items.title: Bite-sized sessions
items.description: Most puzzles finish in five minutes or less, perfect for a quick play break.

items.title: Happy feedback
items.description: Gentle chimes and a confetti burst celebrate every completed picture.

items.title: Adjustable difficulty
items.description: Switch between 6, 12, 24, or 48 pieces to match any skill level.

items.title: No pressure, ever
items.description: There are no timers or fail states, just unlimited tries until it fits.

items.title: Safe for kids
items.description: No ads, no chat, no links out. Just puzzles from start to finish.

items.title: Designed for little hands
items.description: Large, easy-to-grab pieces make dragging and dropping simple on any screen.

stats.title: A whole world of pictures waiting to be completed
